stats.scope_rule: Include limited-channel home/ambulatory sleep-apnea acquisition systems and clearly documented reduced-channel configurations of mixed systems; analyze only the reduced configuration. Exclude full-PSG-only systems, software-only scoring, and components/accessories.

families.applicant: Consolidated Research of Richmond, Inc. Dba General Sleep CO
families.indications_verbatim: The Zmachine Synergy is an EEG and respiratory signal recorder. The device is intended for use by adult patients in the home or clinical environment, under the direction of a qualified healthcare practitioner, to aid in the diagnosis of sleep disorders.
families.scope_basis: Portable adult home recorder with five limited channels: EEG, airflow, respiratory effort, oximetry/pulse, and body position.
families.standardized_outputs: EEG waveform; Airflow waveform; Respiratory-effort waveform; SpO2; Pulse rate; Body position; Recorded study data

families.indication_role: Home sleep testing / aid to diagnosis
families.indications_verbatim: The Cadwell ApneaTrak device is intended for home sleep testing, including the acquisition of physiological and environmental data. The recorded signals are then transmitted to a PC so that they can be viewed. ApneaTrak is intended for use on patients older than 2 years of age. ApneaTrak is intended for use in hospitals, sleep centers and other sleep testing environments, including the patient’s home. ApneaTrak is intended to be used when prescribed by a qualified healthcare provider for use on patients suspected of sleep disorders, specifically Sleep Disordered Breathing (SDB) and requires review by qualified medical personnel. ApneaTrak is NOT intended to perform automatic diagnosis.
families.scope_basis: Home sleep-test recorder with configurable but limited channels; no automatic diagnosis.
families.standardized_outputs: ExG waveforms; Airflow waveform; Respiratory-effort waveform; SpO2; Pulse rate; Body position; Activity; Snoring waveform; Viewed study data

families.family_name: Nox Sleep System — reduced-channel polygraphy configuration
families.indications_verbatim: The Nox Sleep System is used as an aid in the diagnosis of different sleep disorders and for the assessment of sleep. The Nox Sleep System allows the user to decide on the complexity of the study by varying the number and types of physiological signals measured.
families.scope_basis: Included only for the FDA-described simpler polygraphy setup recording a few channels in ambulatory/home use; the full-PSG configuration is outside scope.
families.standardized_outputs: Airflow waveform; Respiratory-effort waveform; SpO2; Pulse rate; Plethysmogram; Snoring; Respiratory-sound waveform; Activity; Body position; AHI; ODI; Apneas; Hypopneas; Apnea classification; Desaturation events; Study report

families.indications_verbatim: The SOMNOscreen plus is a non-life-supporting portable physiological signal recording device intended to be used for testing adults and children/adolescents suspected of having sleep-related breathing disorders.
families.scope_basis: Included only for its modular reduced cardiorespiratory configuration under secondary code MNR; full polysomnography configurations are outside scope.
families.standardized_outputs: Airflow waveform; Respiratory-effort waveform; SpO2; Pulse rate; Snoring waveform; Body position; Activity; Recorded study data; Study report

families.family_name: Cerebra Sleep System — Level 3 HSAT configuration
families.indications_verbatim: The Cerebra Sleep System is intended to be used as a support tool by physicians and PSG technologists to aid in the evaluation and diagnosis of sleep disorders.
families.scope_basis: Included only for the explicitly cleared Level 3 HSAT configuration: at least oxygen saturation, ECG/heart rate, airflow, and respiratory effort; Level 2 PSG is outside scope.
families.standardized_outputs: Airflow waveform; Respiratory-effort waveform; SpO2; Pulse rate; ECG waveform; Heart rate; AHI; RDI; Respiratory events; Study report

families.indications_verbatim: The HomeSleepTest is a non-invasive prescription device for home use with patients suspected to have sleep disorders including sleep-related breathing disorders. The HomeSleepTest is a diagnostic aid for the detection of sleep-related breathing disorders, sleep staging (REM, N1, N2, N3, Wake), and snoring level.
families.scope_basis: Self-applied home test with nine head-unit signals plus ring oximetry; it is a reduced-channel home configuration rather than full PSG.
families.standardized_outputs: EEG waveform; EOG waveform; EMG waveform; Sleep stages; Hypnogram; SpO2; Plethysmogram; Pulse rate; Snoring level; ODI; Autonomic arousal; Time in each sleep stage; Total sleep time; Sleep efficiency; Sleep latency; REM latency; Wake after sleep onset; Body/head position; Study report

families.indications_verbatim: The Falcon HST is an EEG and respiratory signal recorder. The device is intended for use by adult patients in the home or clinical environment, under the direction of a qualified healthcare practitioner, to aid in the diagnosis of sleep disorders.
families.scope_basis: Chest-worn limited-channel home recorder derived from Zmachine Synergy, with EEG and cardiorespiratory channels.
families.standardized_outputs: EEG waveform; EOG waveform; ECG waveform; Airflow waveform; Respiratory-effort waveform; SpO2; Pulse rate; Body position; AHI; Sleep stages; Study report

audit.evidence_excerpt: Summary of Technological Characteristics of Device Compared to Predicates The device has similar indications for use and intended use as the predicate devices.
